headline: Cloudflare shares jump after forecast raise on higher AI-driven spending
summary: Cloudflare shares rose about 16% before the bell after the cloud services firm raised its annual forecasts. The company expects enterprise AI infrastructure spending to boost demand for its networking and security products.
why: Cloudflare is a US-based cloud networking and security company whose revenue depends on enterprise internet infrastructure spending. Its guidance is watched as a read on demand for cloud and AI-related services.

impacts.name: Cloudflare
impacts.why: The company raised its annual forecasts, which directly lifts investor expectations for its revenue.
